items: The project manager requested a progress ____ from every team leader.
A progress 'update' provides the latest information about a project's status.
The company's annual sales ____ exceeded expectations in the fourth quarter.
'Revenue' is income generated from business activities such as sales.
The damaged package was returned to the carrier for ____.
An 'inspection' is a careful examination to check condition or compliance.
The executive assistant arranged ground ____ from the airport to the hotel.
'Transportation' means the service or means of moving people or goods.
The software license must be renewed before its expiration ____.
An expiration 'date' is the date after which a license or document is no longer valid.
The supplier offered a volume ____ for orders exceeding 500 units.
A volume 'discount' is a price reduction for buying a large quantity.
The customer asked for written ____ that the order had been canceled.
'Confirmation' is evidence or a statement establishing that something has been completed or arranged.
The office manager ordered additional stationery because current ____ were running low.
'Supplies' are materials or items kept for routine business use.
The company will announce the successful job ____ early next week.
A job 'candidate' is a person being considered for a position.
The meeting room is unavailable because routine ____ is being performed on the air-conditioning system.
'Maintenance' is work done to keep equipment or facilities in good condition.
The contract requires written ____ from both parties before any major change is made.
The warehouse uses barcode scanners to improve order ____.
Order 'accuracy' is the degree to which orders are prepared without errors.
The restaurant manager reviewed the weekend staffing ____ before approving leave requests.
A staffing 'schedule' shows when employees are assigned to work.
The purchasing officer placed an urgent ____ for replacement printer cartridges.
An 'order' is a formal request to purchase goods or services.
The company offered relocation ____ to employees transferred overseas.
'Assistance' means help or support provided for a task or situation.
The branch exceeded its monthly sales ____ for the third consecutive month.
A sales 'target' is a planned or desired level of sales performance.
The manager requested a detailed cost ____ before approving the renovation.
A cost 'breakdown' separates a total cost into its component amounts.
The customer service team tracks average response ____ for incoming inquiries.
Response 'time' is the amount of time taken to reply or react.
The company conducted a security ____ after several employees received suspicious emails.
A security 'review' is an examination of security practices or risks.
The manufacturer increased its safety ____ after introducing automated equipment.
Safety 'standards' are established requirements or levels for safe operation.
The training coordinator recorded each participant's ____ on the sign-in sheet.
'Attendance' indicates whether and how many people are present at an event.
The supplier guaranteed next-day ____ for orders placed before noon.
'Delivery' is the transportation and handover of goods to a recipient.
The manager asked employees to submit vacation ____ at least two weeks in advance.
Vacation 'requests' are formal applications for time off.
The warehouse installed additional lighting to improve workplace ____.
Workplace 'safety' refers to conditions and practices that prevent injury.
The finance team asked the vendor to clarify the payment ____ listed in the contract.
Payment 'terms' are the conditions governing when and how payment must be made.
